scope: User-authorized ALL 21 AZ ML ambitions: durable planning inventory, not an execution authority or delivery claim.
dependency_semantics: Capability dependencies are integration/validation gates, not prerequisites for exploratory inventory or CPU stage work. Stage work may start through the execution board before full dependency completion. Declared completion is not production certification.
nonclaims: Capabilities 1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 8, 10, 11, 13, 14, 18 and 20 have tested reference or integration milestones in progress; no full ambition is declared completed.
Baseline adapters are planned comparison interfaces enabling original AZ algorithms; wrappers alone do not satisfy completion.
External prerequisites are unverified requirements, not installed or delivered optional backends.
No universal lossless tokenizer conversion across incompatible segmentation, normalization, vocabulary, and special-token semantics is possible.
This register grants no host access, deployment authority, model certification, or hardgate physics status.

capabilities.name: Sub-4-bit quantization
external_prerequisites: Licensed calibration models and held-out evaluation data
Explicit quantization backend/version selection and installation
Authorized CUDA benchmark host
acceptance_gates: Demonstrate actual packed weights below 4 bits per weight including metadata accounting
Report held-out quality loss and throughput versus matched FP16 and 4-bit baselines
Validate original AZ quantizer against baseline adapter with reproducible seeds and receipts
capabilities.next_action: Address the recorded task-generalization failures using validation on unseen computations and a fresh preregistered 30/30 gate, without reusing exposed tests for selection. Then reassess 3-bit quality on a useful model, compare independent quantizers and licensed application models, and obtain accelerator evidence.
hardware_requirements: CPU for packing reference tests
CUDA GPU with sufficient VRAM for measured kernels
baseline_adapters: Planned pinned bitsandbytes or GPTQ comparison adapter; not integrated
capabilities.original_algorithm_goal: Develop an AZ mixed-precision packing and calibration algorithm with independently measured quality/size tradeoffs.
capabilities.nonclaim: The original 3.3966-bit artifact failed fidelity. Validation-only calibration selected a 3.4414-bit artifact passing the unchanged fidelity limits on the exposed historical diagnostic, not a fresh qualification. Native answer accuracy remains 0/30. Independent all-gradient/update parity does not establish generalization, GPU or deployment utility.
